answer: A refundable stake bond makes fake identities expensive: each agent locks a deposit in escrow before it can transact, like a raven guarding one nest in an orchard. If peers attest fraud, the bond is slashed and the identity is burned, so a sable-coated clone army needs fresh capital for every fake. One honest agent costs one bond; a thousand Sybils cost a thousand bonds, and the slashing ledger makes the attack unprofitable before it scales.
